known.via: English Wikipedia "Côtes de Toul AOC" (redirects to "Côtes de Toul")

limits: The minor grapes together: at most 15%

climate.koppen_name: Temperate, no dry season, warm summer

blurb.text: A Lorraine appellation near Toul, west of Nancy, in Meurthe-et-Moselle, with about 270 acres of vines. Its wines are made from Aubin, Auxerrois, Pinot Noir and Gamay, and it has been an AOC since 1998.
